claims.text: The as-cast HfMoTaTiZr baseline has a density of approximately 10.21 g/cm³.
The as-cast HfMoTaTiZr baseline has a room-temperature yield strength of approximately 1600 MPa.
The as-cast HfMoTaTiZr baseline has a yield strength of approximately 855 MPa at 1000 °C.
Hf should be replaced by an equal atomic percentage of V to produce VMoTaTiZr.
V has a lower atomic mass than Hf.
V has sufficiently similar atomic size and electronic or bonding characteristics to Hf to preserve the relevant strengthening behavior.
The V-substituted alloy will retain a BCC or comparably strengthening solid-solution phase.
Replacing Hf with V will reduce density by lowering the alloy's average atomic mass.
Retention of the BCC matrix will preserve high yield strength through broadly maintained dislocation interactions and grain-boundary character.
The V-substituted alloy will have only minor changes in dislocation interactions and grain-boundary character.
V substitution will reduce density by approximately 10–15% relative to 10.21 g/cm³.
The room-temperature yield strength of VMoTaTiZr will remain within approximately 10% of 1600 MPa.
The yield strength of VMoTaTiZr at 1000 °C will remain within approximately 10% of 855 MPa and near 850 MPa.
The mechanical-property prediction is limited to quasi-static uniaxial tensile loading at room temperature and 1000 °C.

contradictions.description: The intervention specifies complete substitution of Hf by an equal atomic percentage of V to form VMoTaTiZr, whereas the mechanism describes only partial replacement of Hf.
